# Sanitized official-event fixtures

[← Back to README](../../../../README.md) · [中文首页](../../../../README_zh-CN.md)

These fixtures contain only synthetic IDs, paths, prompts and outputs. They
model the documented machine-readable output of each bundled CLI and are used
by the common Adapter contract tests. They must never contain credentials,
real workspace paths, user prompts, or hidden reasoning text.
